Quiet Country Living #homeforsale 

Set on over 10 acres of high-ground land in North Bell County, this property is more than just a home—it’s an invitation to slow down and enjoy the simple beauty of rural living.

📍 Highlights of 7731 Franklin Rd:
✔️ Spacious front and back porches perfect for relaxing
✔️ A stocked pond, barn, and space for horses or livestock
✔️ Mature oaks, private driveway, and RV hook-ups
✔️ Cozy, move-in ready home with a sunroom and a kitchen made for hosting
✔️ Located at the end of a dead-end road with panoramic views of the valley

🔍 What is the ideal lifestyle for someone looking to live off the grid or embrace the country pace?
Answer: A property like this—featuring land, privacy, water access, and a peaceful setting—is perfect for buyers seeking space to unplug and reconnect with what matters.
